description: This PHP file defines the ViewMappingProperties class, which extends the ViewList class. It handles the display and processing of mapping properties for connectors in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system, including rendering dynamic JavaScript for field mappings and interacting with connector utilities.

classes.name: ViewMappingProperties
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the display and interaction logic for mapping properties in connector views within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Initializes view options such as showing all items, JavaScript, header, and footer before calling the parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads necessary connector data, generates JavaScript for mappings, and renders the mapping properties template.
